source.title: Semantic Sensor Network Ontology

reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: An OWL-class abstraction for pieces of infrastructure implementing Procedures; component Systems can be other Systems.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Does not itself define a single physical enclosure, installed station, deployed serial asset, CSAPI System resource or complete hardware bill of materials.

reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: An entity that hosts Sensors, Actuators, Samplers or other Platforms; examples include posts, buoys, vehicles, phones and people.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Hosting or mounting is not physical-part containment; a station coordinate cannot establish an individual probe point or original installation history.

reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: Reusable workflow, protocol, plan, algorithm or method for observation, sampling, or actuation.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: It covers more than observing, and its declaration does not prove a historic procedure execution or effective on-device configuration.

reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: An observable quality/characteristic of a feature-of-interest, connected to observations via observedProperty.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: A property is neither its numeric result nor a physical PM sensor module; temperature of an enclosure panel is not necessarily ambient air temperature.

reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: A device, agent including a human, or software/simulation implementing sensing procedures and generating results.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Not necessarily one physical probe, logger, reported stream, or identifiably authenticated performer of Bennett's historical 15-minute mean.

reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: The actual activity of applying a procedure to estimate/calculate a property of a feature-of-interest, linked to sensor, property, result and time.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: A manufacturer example is not an executed Observation; copying two NOAA source events into four API records does not create four original acts; original resultTime remains UNKNOWN.

nativeLeads.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Relates System to component System, but physical-part completeness and assembly hierarchy do not automatically follow.
Hosting and mounted-on roles must not be silently converted to material containment, point coordinates or time-dated service.
A deployment description does not establish the exact Bennett EE181 exchange minute, verified sensor site point or current state.
A reusable method, implementation capability, and actual historical procedure execution are different claims.
Procedure input/output information is not necessarily a logger telemetry field, network endpoint or addressed transducer channel.
Observed ambient air, sensor hardware, physical station and station coordinate are not the same feature.
Observation result instance/value differs from an output-field definition, observation act, and copied project representation.
Time of applicability may be an interval for a mean, and differs from resultTime; do not invent exact Bennett interval boundaries.
Result-completion instant for original NOAA record is UNKNOWN; must not substitute retrieval time or project API publication time.
Original mean-producing Sensor attribution cannot be asserted from station listing or associated probe inventory alone.
Capability and operating-range declarations are not measured present battery state, diagnostics, or verified operating conditions.
Actuation as world-changing activity must not be equated to a Command request, acknowledgement, success code, or measured effect.

exactCaseLimits: Dragino, AirGradient and Campbell are manufacturer reference/design/source examples, not authenticated fielded Observation evidence.
Bennett has two original NOAA 2024 air-temperature mean events with four project API representations; no new source events inferred.
Bennett original resultTime UNKNOWN; station site point not verified EE181 individual probe coordinate.
SOSA/SSN 2017 vocabulary axioms do not authenticate a 2024 issuer, original event producing Sensor, or full CSAPI conformance.
excluded: No new DIM row, changed proposed DIM label or formally adopted model commitment.
No 2026 W3C draft changes promoted into 2017 Recommendation.
No The Open Group SOSA architecture conflated with W3C SOSA acronym.
No deployed native CSAPI/Glaux/server/cloud change or equipment Commands.
